text:
Maria: quick experiment idea — guest-led mini-webinar + segmented credit buckets to nudge activation. Two arms: 'Live guest + 100 credits' vs 'Prompt templates drip + 50 credits' vs control. Target: new signups in last 7 days who haven't completed onboarding.

Lee: metrics? how we define activation?

Maria: primary = first meaningful generation (>=1 successful completion using a prompt template). Secondary = credit burn in 7d, webinar attendance, and SDR conversions.

Aj: landing + email creative — I can do 2 CTA variants (Register / Try templates) and 3 prompt packs. ETA Tue.

Sophie: routing question — inbound webinar signups: do we route org emails to SDRs or keep everything self-serve? Need clarity for handoff.

Maria: propose simple routing rule: if company email domain && usage_tokens > 50 then route to SDR queue (tag = 'webinar-sdr'), else auto nurture. Pseudocode: 
```
if (email_domain != 'gmail' && usage_tokens > 50) route = "sdr-webinar"
else route = "self-serve-nurture"
```
This keeps high-intent leads moving to sales.

Nate: please add UTM params + event `experiment_guest_webinar` to our analytics pipeline. Also suggest distinct promo codes per cohort so credit redemptions map back to arms.

OnboardBot: Reminder: draft event created — /events/rdw-guest-webinar (Thu 5pm PT). Automated reminder scheduled 24h before.

Maria: I'll draft the experiment doc & copy and add tracking details. @Aj can you produce the 2 CTAs + screenshot assets by Tue EOD?

Aj: Yep — will deliver CTAs + 3 prompt packs named "starter", "build", "refine". I'll add version tags for A/B.

Lee: run duration 14 days, traffic split 40/40/20. Benchmarks: baseline activation = 12% (current), target lift = +6 percentage points. Postmortem metrics: activation lift, cost-per-activation (credits burned / incremental activations), webinar attendance rate, and SDR conversion rate for routed leads.

Sophie: quick compliance note — ensure recording consent language is included on signup and that recordings follow retention policy.

Maria: great. I'll update the doc with cohort filters, tracking checklist, and the exact copy. Sharing link after lunch. Thanks all! :rocket:
